what: Small figures (people, trees, signs) hide at the bottom right (x 13~18, y 30~40) tilted by .025~.05π, and pop upright over .75s when they enter the screen — height and tilt overshoot once with back.out(8) before settling, the sides use power2.out, and opacity uses .3s expo.out. With several, they stagger by .05s (the figures when a drawer opens). For a smaller pop like the history pieces, use y 10~15 and x 3~8

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Bouncing graphics (children, multiple) — if none, the element itself
options.on: ”load” as soon as it opens · ”event” each time the element receives fx:play (opening the drawer) · if none is set, once when it enters the screen
options.y: Range of distance coming from below (px), default 30,40
options.x: Distance range coming from the right (px), default 13,18

note: /  When attached to a piece inside an SVG, the using side sets transform-box: fill-box so the axis fits the piece’s box · side distance · tilt are the original mm random numbers — with even odds the start value’s sign flips (mm(a, b) = a~b or −a~b−2a) also comes from the left and the opposite tilt

from.where: shared.js people over button (peopleHover) — original Wm (images entering on scroll · images at .05s intervals when the drawer opens)
shared.js rise() (history scroll pieces) — original nF.show: y 10~15 · x 3~8, .06s between pieces
